t: Elevating the Notebook: From Hidden Factory to Welcoming Foyer
s: A software architecture journal entry detailing a refactor to make a 'sausage factory' (code-driven data processing system) more accessible. The breakthrough involved reorganizing folder structure, revealing an 'embedded repository' Git issue, and solving it through consolidation, emphasizing AI ergonomics.
sub: Project folder structure refactoring for accessibility
Designing for AI ergonomics in software projects
Philosophical shift from 'hidden factory' to 'welcoming foyer'
